meta.name: MELANIA the Series
meta.description: Experience Melania Trump's transition to First Lady as she navigates the White House and puts her mission into action.

videos.title: I Family & Trust
videos.overview: Melania Trump sets priorities as she prepares to become America's First Lady. But inside the White House, trust is tested, and the incoming First Lady must protect those closest to her while navigating the demands of power.

videos.title: II Pride & Honor
videos.overview: The honor of serving as First Lady comes with an immediate call to action. Moments after the inauguration, First Lady Melania Trump sets her mission in motion for the American people.
